# Test fixtures

All fixtures are generated by `tools/make_fixtures.py` against an unmodified
`apache/nifi` Docker image. No real customer flows are used. Regenerate with:

```bash
python tools/make_fixtures.py --nifi-version 1.28.1
```

Regeneration produces new component identifiers, so golden files must be
refreshed afterwards (`pytest --update-golden`). Besides the analyzer
reports, `tests/golden/nifi-1.28.1/migrate-variables/` holds the migrated
flow, `changes.json` and the post-migration report of `flow.json.gz`,
`definitions/variables.json` and `definitions/existing-context.json`.

## `nifi-1.28.1/`

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `flow.json.gz` | The whole canvas as written by NiFi 1.28.1 (`conf/flow.json.gz`), re-compressed with a fixed timestamp. |
| `flow.json` | The same, decompressed. |
| `definitions/<group>.json` | Flow definition of each top-level process group (`GET /process-groups/{id}/download`). |
| `templates/<name>.xml` | XML template exported from the instance (`GET /templates/{id}/download`). |

### Process groups and the rule categories they exercise

| Group | Exercises |
|---|---|
| `Variables` | Variables at three nesting levels (`Variables` > `Child` > `Grandchild`), a shadowed name (`shared`), an unused variable, a name that is not a valid parameter name (`bad name!`). References from properties with EL scope `VARIABLE_REGISTRY` (ListenHTTP, GenerateFlowFile, GetFile), `FLOWFILE_ATTRIBUTES` (PutFile, UpdateAttribute dynamic property), no EL support (LogAttribute "Attributes to Log"), and an EL function applied to a variable (TailFile). |
| `Existing Context` | Group with a parameter context (`Fixture Context`, inheriting `Base Context`) and variables, one of which (`host`) collides with a parameter name. |
| `Removed Components` | Processors removed in 2.x from the standard NAR (GetHTTP, PostHTTP, HashContent, HashAttribute, Base64EncodeContent, ListenTCPRecord, ParseCEF, ListenRELP, PutJMS, GetJMSQueue, ConvertJSONToSQL, EncryptContent) and from other NARs (PutSlack, ConsumeKafka_2_6, PutElasticsearchHttp, PutAzureBlobStorage); JoltTransformJSON whose bundle moved; DistributedMapCacheServer and DistributedMapCacheClientService which were renamed; an UpdateAttribute that must not be flagged. The root also has a PrometheusReportingTask. |
| `Scripting` | ExecuteScript with python (Jython), ECMAScript, ruby, lua and Groovy engines; InvokeScriptedProcessor with python; ScriptedTransformRecord with Groovy; ScriptedLookupService with python; ScriptedReader with Groovy. |
| `Scheduling` | An `EVENT_DRIVEN` processor; cron expressions with a seventh (year) field and with a numeric day of week; a cron expression that is unaffected. |
| `Deprecated Properties` | InvokeHTTP configured with the deprecated `Proxy Host` / `Proxy Port` properties. |
| `Custom NAR` | One processor whose type and bundle were rewritten after export to `com.example.nifi.processors.CustomProcessor` / `com.example:example-custom-nar:1.0.0`. NiFi cannot create an unknown type through the API; the rewrite mimics a flow that references a third-party NAR. |
| `Clean` | Input and output ports, a funnel, a label, a parameter context and only components that work unchanged on 2.x. Expected to produce no findings. |

The template `Removed Components Template` contains the first four processors
of `Removed Components` and is also embedded in `flow.json` under `templates`.
